business_summary: Beijing Chieftain Control Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated intelligent manufacturing system solutions for the biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical industries in China and internationally. It operates through Automation and Rehabilitation Medical segments. The company offers powder equipment comprising dust-free pulverizing systems, pulsed airflow mixing systems, automatic lifting hopping mixers, dust-free feeding stations, ton bad unloading machines, vacuum conveying equipment, metering and dispensing machines, CIP cleaning units, and dry granulators; aseptic isolation equipment consisting of aseptic isolation dispensing and feeding systems, restricted access isolation systems, negative pressure isolation operating systems, and reactor isolation feeding systems; gas chlorine dioxide sterilization equipment; and intelligent packaging equipment. It also provides valve products, such as diaphragm valve, gate valve, diaphragm gate valve, and other biomedical products; and professional medical equipment, including target-controlled, infusion, and nutrient pumps. In addition, the company offers intelligent manufacturing automation overall, intelligent manufacturing information system, intelligent equipment system overall, gas chlorine dioxide sterilization, and rehabilitation medical solutions. Further, it is involved in the servicing of rehabilitation medical equipment; and software, property management, and technology promotion services. The company exports its products. The company was formerly known as Beijing Chieftain Control Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Beijing Chieftain Control Technology Group Co., Ltd. in September 2024. Beijing Chieftain Control Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Beijing Chieftain Control Technology Group Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 해외의 바이오제약 및 제약 산업을 위한 통합 지능형 ​​제조 시스템 솔루션을 제공합니다. 자동화 및 재활 의료 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 무분진 분쇄 시스템, 펄스 기류 혼합 시스템, 자동 리프팅 호핑 믹서, 무진 공급 스테이션, 톤 불량 하역 기계, 진공 운반 장비, 계량 및 분배 기계, CIP 세척 장치 및 건식 과립기로 구성된 분말 장비를 제공합니다. 무균 격리 분배 및 공급 시스템, 제한된 접근 격리 시스템, 음압 격리 운영 시스템 및 반응기 격리 공급 시스템으로 구성된 무균 격리 장비; 가스 이산화염소 살균 장비; 지능형 포장 장비. 또한 다이어프램 밸브, 게이트 밸브, 다이어프램 게이트 밸브 및 기타 생물 의학 제품과 같은 밸브 제품을 제공합니다. 표적 제어, 주입 및 영양 펌프를 포함한 전문 의료 장비. 또한 회사는 전반적으로 지능형 제조 자동화를 제공합니다.
